title: DUET: fast two-part hurdle testing for single-cell differential expression in Python
description:
DUET (Detection-Expression Unified Test) is a from-scratch implementation of the MAST-style two-part hurdle test for single-cell differential expression: a logistic detection model and a Gaussian positive-expression model whose likelihood-ratio statistics are summed into a single chi-squared test.

It operates directly on sparse AnnData objects with no R toolchain and no disk round-trip. On the two-group design without covariates it fits 117x faster than R MAST at 11,106 cells and 149x at 23,895 cells, in substantially less memory, while reproducing MAST's coefficients and gene ranking. It additionally reports an underflow-safe -log10 p, recovering gene rankings that MAST, diffxpy and scanpy lose to double-precision underflow at realistic cell counts.
